records.title: Comprehend and apply universal knowledge
records.text: Comprehend and apply advanced engineering knowledge of the widely applied principles underpinning good practices.
records.embed_text: Comprehend and apply universal knowledge. Comprehend and apply advanced engineering knowledge of the widely applied principles underpinning good practices.

records.title: Comprehend and apply local knowledge
records.text: Comprehend and apply advanced engineering knowledge of the widely applied principles underpinning good practice specific to the jurisdiction of practices.
records.embed_text: Comprehend and apply local knowledge. Comprehend and apply advanced engineering knowledge of the widely applied principles underpinning good practice specific to the jurisdiction of practices.

records.title: Problem analysis
records.text: Define, investigate and analyze complex engineering problems using data and information technologies where applicable.
records.embed_text: Problem analysis. Define, investigate and analyze complex engineering problems using data and information technologies where applicable.

records.title: Design and development of solutions
records.text: Design or develop solutions to complex engineering problems considering a variety of perspectives and taking account of stakeholder views.
records.embed_text: Design and development of solutions. Design or develop solutions to complex engineering problems considering a variety of perspectives and taking account of stakeholder views.

records.title: Evaluation
records.text: Evaluate the outcomes and impacts of complex engineering activities.
records.embed_text: Evaluation. Evaluate the outcomes and impacts of complex engineering activities.

records.title: Protection of society
records.text: Recognize the foreseeable economic, social and environmental effects of complex engineering activities and seek to achieve sustainable outcomes.
records.embed_text: Protection of society. Recognize the foreseeable economic, social and environmental effects of complex engineering activities and seek to achieve sustainable outcomes.

records.title: Legal, regulatory and cultural
records.text: Meet all legal, regulatory and cultural requirements and protect public health and safety in the course of all engineering activities.
records.embed_text: Legal, regulatory and cultural. Meet all legal, regulatory and cultural requirements and protect public health and safety in the course of all engineering activities.

records.title: Manage engineering activities
records.text: Manage part or all of one or more complex engineering activities.
records.embed_text: Manage engineering activities. Manage part or all of one or more complex engineering activities.

records.title: Communication and collaboration
records.text: Communicate and collaborate using multiple media clearly and inclusively with a broad range of stakeholders in the course of all engineering activities.
records.embed_text: Communication and collaboration. Communicate and collaborate using multiple media clearly and inclusively with a broad range of stakeholders in the course of all engineering activities.

records.title: Continuing professional development and lifelong learning
records.text: Undertake continuing professional development activities to maintain and extend competences and enhance the ability to adapt to emerging technologies and the ever-changing nature of work.
records.embed_text: Continuing professional development and lifelong learning. Undertake continuing professional development activities to maintain and extend competences and enhance the ability to adapt to emerging technologies and the ever-changing nature of work.

records.title: Judgement
records.text: Recognize complexity and assess alternatives in light of competing requirements and incomplete knowledge. Exercise sound judgement in the course of all complex engineering activities.
records.embed_text: Judgement. Recognize complexity and assess alternatives in light of competing requirements and incomplete knowledge. Exercise sound judgement in the course of all complex engineering activities.

records.title: Responsibility for decisions
records.text: Be responsible for making decisions on part or all of the complex engineering activities.
